purpose: Find material with actual primary entity spelling failures, then evaluate frozen module; not a latency or population-quality benchmark.
selection_basis: Unprompted current Qwen raw_screen completed before repair run. Whole first600seconds retained, no audio corruption, no synthetic concatenation.
core_policy: Core spelling cases and already-correct controls counted; 3 name-order/spoken variants excluded from core scoring. All labels remain subject to independent human listening adjudication.
reference_policy: Only entity spellings corrected with publisher/university/historical references. Rest copied from raw screen, so no CER. Exact source programme attribution not verified beyond matching repost metadata.
glossary_policy: 53 known-topic names/terms with plausible absent distractors, no error aliases, current default thresholds unchanged.
quality_delivery: Accelerated 1s PCM packets; CTC real-audio worker awaited after each packet to avoid synthetic queue overrun; same runtime and module, no downstream Web refiner.
